era: 1019 年生于陕州夏县涑水乡一个官宦诗书之家——父司马池官至天章阁待制，以清直知名；七岁'凛然如成人，闻讲《左氏春秋》，即能了其大指'，回家即与兄论讲不辍；同年破瓮救友，'京、洛间画以为图'；宝元元年 (1038) 二十岁中进士，'性不喜华靡'，闻喜宴独不戴花——'簪一枝花，何伤也'的劝语下才簪一朵；历仕仁宗英宗神宗三朝，官至知制诰、翰林学士；1061 年前后仁宗无嗣，他连上数疏请早定储嗣，'臣言此，自谓必死'并预买棺材待罪；王安石行新法，他以《与王介甫书》三千言力争'侵官、生事、征利、拒谏'，辞枢密副使不就；1071 年退居洛阳十五年，'专以书局为事'，居独乐园、以圆木为'警枕'，与刘恕、刘攽、范祖禹三大助手分任丛目长编——'臣之精力，尽于此书'：1084 年《资治通鉴》二百九十四卷成书进呈，神宗赐序；1085 年神宗崩，太皇太后召其入京执政，元祐更化尽废新法，以尚书左丞拜左相；1086 年 9 月病卒于位，'京师人为之罢市往吊，鬻衣以致奠'——遗表不言时政，'平生所为，未尝有不可对人言者'
era_en: Born 1019 in Sushui, Xia county, Shanzhou, into an official family of letters — his father Sima Chi rose to a Readership-in-Waiting of the Tianzhang Pavilion, known for integrity; at seven 'grave as a grown man, on hearing the Zuo Commentary expounded he at once grasped its great purport', returning home to expound it to his brothers without pause; the same year he smashed the jar to save a drowning companion, 'painted as a picture in the capitals'; in 1038, at twenty, he passed the jinshi, 'by nature disliking showiness', alone of the banquet geese refusing the court flower — accepting one bloom only at the urging 'what harm in one flower'; he served Renzong, Yingzong and Shenzong, rising to Drafter and Academician; when Renzong died heirless, around 1061 he memorialised again and again for naming an heir — 'speaking this, I expect to die' — and bought his coffin in advance; when Wang Anshi launched the New Policies he fought with a three-thousand-word letter charging 'usurped offices, stirred affairs, squeezed profit, refused counsel', and declined the Privy Council; from 1071 he withdrew to Luoyang for fifteen years, 'giving himself wholly to the book office', in the Garden of Solitude, sleeping on a round log as his 'warning pillow', with Liu Shu, Liu Ban and Fan Zuyu dividing catalogue and long draft — 'whatever strength your servant has was spent on this book': in 1084 the Comprehensive Mirror, 294 scrolls, was presented with the emperor's preface; in 1085 Shenzong died, the Grand Dowager summoned him to power, the Yuanyou restoration abolished the New Policies, and he rose to chancellor of the left; in September 1086 he died in office — 'the capital's people closed their shops to mourn, selling clothes to fund the offerings'; his deathbed memorial said nothing of policy: 'in all my life, nothing I could not say to another's face'
school: 编年史学与考证方法论 / 名分政治哲学 / 保守主义改革论 / 士大夫言责伦理 / 俭德与家训制度
historical_significance: 北宋士大夫政治的完型样本：他与王安石的争论是中国改革史上'渐进与激进'最著名的对垒，而真正传世的是他政治失败期间写成的《资治通鉴》——二百九十四卷编年巨著、一千三百六十二年治乱兴衰，'鉴于往事，有资于治道'，成为此后千年中国执政者的案头教科书；他发明的'考异'体例把史学从抄录变成可检验的裁决，其证据纪律领先世界史学数百年；七岁破瓮、圆木警枕、预买棺材进谏、训俭示康——他把个人品格锻造成一套可传的纪律装置；元祐更化尽废新法常被史家批评为'复辟'，但'治天下譬如居室，敝则修之，非大坏不更造也'的修屋哲学，为保守主义式的渐进改革提供了中国文本中最清晰的表述；他死时'天下皆是之'的哀荣与身后'家家有象'的传诵，标志一个以史为鉴、以俭养德、以尽言为天职的士大夫伦理的完成
historical_significance_en: The completed specimen of Northern Song literati statesmanship: his contest with Wang Anshi remains the most famous duel of gradualism against radicalism in Chinese reform history, yet what endures is the Comprehensive Mirror written in the years of his political defeat — 294 annalistic scrolls, 1,362 years of order and collapse, 'mirroring the past to resource the way of governance', the desk textbook of Chinese rulers for a millennium after; his invention of the kaoyi turned history from transcription into testable adjudication, an evidentiary discipline centuries ahead of world historiography; the jar smashed at seven, the log pillow, the coffin bought before remonstrance, the thrift taught to his son — he forged personal character into a transmissible apparatus of discipline; the Yuanyou abolition of the New Policies is often censured as restoration, but his philosophy — 'to govern is to dwell in a house: when it rots, repair it; never rebuild until wholly ruined' — remains the clearest statement in Chinese letters of a conservative gradualism; the mourning of the whole realm at his death and the 'likeness in every household' after it mark the completion of an ethic of the scholar-official: history as mirror, thrift as the ground of virtue, the full word as vocation
unique_thinking: 司马光的思维内核是'以史为治之镜'的认识论：知识的最高形态是经过考异的、可检索的过去——《通鉴》不是怀旧的古董而是治理的实验数据库，编年为骨使任何决策可定位到'此前发生过什么'，考异使读者看到证据而非只看到结论；第二个内核是'名实相稽'的政治本体论：名分是权力的操作系统，名实错位在先、秩序崩坏在后——'不是三家灭了晋，是名先死了'，守住名分比打赢战争更重要；第三个内核是装置化的自我治理：圆木警枕、日结切片、可公示测试——意志靠不住，就让物体替你执法；第四个内核是双轴的影响力观：权力轴失败即切文本轴，屏居洛阳十五年把政治挫败复利成传世文本，在野声望是在朝影响力的期权；他的一切方法背后是同一条底线——'平生所为，未尝有不可对人言者'：俭是对欲望的预算约束，尽言是对话语的预算约束，修屋是对变革的预算约束——一个把节制当作最高智慧的人
unique_thinking_en: Sima Guang's cognitive core is the epistemology of history as the mirror of governance: knowledge at its highest is the past after kaoyi — searchable; the Mirror is no antique of nostalgia but an experimental database of governance, its annalistic skeleton letting any decision be located against 'what had happened before', its kaoyi letting the reader see the evidence and not only the conclusion; his second core is the political ontology of auditing name against reality: name-and-rank is the operating system of power; misalignment precedes collapse — 'the three houses did not destroy Jin; the name died first', and guarding the name outranks winning the war; the third core is self-governance by device: the log pillow, the daily-closable slice, the sayable-to-another's-face test — willpower cannot be trusted, so let objects enforce the law; the fourth is the two-axis view of influence: losing the power axis, switch to the text axis — fifteen years in Luoyang compounding political defeat into a transmissible text, out-of-power repute the call option on in-power influence; beneath all his methods runs one bottom line — 'in all my life, nothing I could not say to another's face': thrift is the budget constraint on desire, speaking-wholly the budget constraint on words, house-repair the budget constraint on change — a man who held restraint to be the highest wisdom
civilization_zh: 北宋士大夫政治：科举与官僚铨选塑造的士人责任伦理、党争生态（新旧党争的攻防与'君子和而不同'的破坏）、编年史学的千年传统与《左传》叙事范式、洛阳退居文人社群与独乐园的书房政治、宗法社会对家礼与家范的制度需求、理学兴起前夜的'格物'与'治心'工夫论、中原王朝对治乱兴亡的集体焦虑与'以史为鉴'的资政传统
civilization_en: Northern Song literati politics: the ethic of responsibility shaped by the examination system and bureaucratic selection, the ecology of partisan strife (the offence and defence of the New and Old Policies and the ruinous ideal of 'gentlemen agreeing in difference'), the thousand-year tradition of annalistic historiography and the narrative paradigm of the Zuo Commentary, the study-politics of the Luoyang retired-literati community and the Garden of Solitude, the institutional demand of the lineage society for family ritual and family models, the praxis of 'investigating things' and 'governing the mind' on the eve of Neo-Confucianism's rise, and the collective anxiety of the Central Kingdom over order and collapse — the tradition of governing by looking into history
roles_zh: 史学家（《资治通鉴》主编、考异体例发明者）；政治家（仁宗英宗神宗三朝翰林学士、元祐左相）；改革哲学家（'修屋渐进'保守改革论的表述者）；伦理家（《训俭示康》《家范》的家训作者）；言责伦理的践行者（预买棺材进谏）
roles_en: Historian (editor-in-chief of the Comprehensive Mirror, inventor of the kaoyi); statesman (Academician under three reigns, chancellor of the left in Yuanyou); philosopher of reform (the clearest Chinese statement of conservative gradualism); ethicist (author of the Family Models and the Thrift Discourse to Kang); practitioner of the vocation of speech (the coffin bought before remonstrance)

modes.domain_zh: 史学方法论/把历史写成治理的实验室——以编年为骨、以治乱为纲，让过去成为可检索的决策数据库
modes.domain_en: Historiographical methodology / writing history as the laboratory of governance — annals for the skeleton, order and collapse for the spine, making the past a searchable database of decisions
modes.definition_zh: 史学方法论/司马光编《资治通鉴》的目的写得很直白：'鉴前世之兴衰，考当今之得失'——历史不是怀旧的古董而是治理的实验数据库；为此他做了三项工程：其一取编年为骨——'使先后有伦、精粗不杂'，把一千三百六十二年压进时间轴，让任何决策都能定位到'此前发生过什么'；其二以'关国家兴衰、系生民休戚'为收录标准，'善可为法、恶可为戒'者才入书，其余'不特立传'——数据库有主题，不收杂项；其三发明'考异'——同一件事诸书抵牾时，把异说并列并注明取舍理由，让读者看到证据而不是只看到结论；《通鉴》不是写完的书，是架好的显微镜：皇帝翻到任何一年，都能看见'权力在这个位置上曾经怎么用、后果如何'
modes.definition_en: Historiographical methodology: Sima Guang stated the aim of the Comprehensive Mirror plainly — 'to mirror the rise and fall of former ages and examine today's gains and losses'; history is not an antique of nostalgia but an experimental database of governance; for this he built three things: first, annals as skeleton — 'so that order succeeds order and the fine and coarse do not mix', pressing 1,362 years onto a single timeline so any decision can be located against 'what had happened before'; second, an admission rule — only what 'bears on the rise and fall of states and the welfare of the people', where 'good may serve as model and evil as warning', enters the book, and the rest gets no biography — a database has a subject and takes no miscellany; third, the invention of 'examination of variants' (kaoyi): when accounts conflict, the variants stand side by side with the reason for the choice noted — the reader sees the evidence, not only the conclusion; the Mirror is not a finished book but an aligned microscope: the emperor opens to any year and sees how power was used at that position, and what it cost
modes.source_chapter: 《资治通鉴》进书表 (1084)；司马光《与范内翰论修书帖》
modes.key_quote_zh: 鉴前世之兴衰，考当今之得失——历史是用来翻检的镜子，不是用来收藏的古董。
modes.key_quote_en: Mirror the rise and fall of former ages; examine today's gains and losses — history is a mirror to be consulted, not an antique to be collected.
key_concepts: 编年为骨 annals as skeleton（千三百年压进一条时间轴——任何决策可定位到'此前发生过什么'）
annals as skeleton (thirteen centuries on one timeline — any decision locatable against what came before)
主题准入 subject-gated admission（'关兴衰、系休戚'才入书——数据库只收与治理有关的记录）
subject-gated admission (only what bears on rise-and-fall and popular welfare enters — the database takes only governance-relevant records)
考异存真 the kaoyi device（异说并列并注明取舍——展示证据而非只给结论）
the kaoyi device (variants set side by side with the choice justified — show the evidence, not only the verdict)
process_zh: 定题准入：先写下'这条记录要回答什么治理问题'——与主题无关的史料一概不入库
编年为骨：把所有事件压进统一时间轴，先保'先后有伦'再谈解释——时序错乱的因果一律不采
考异存真：诸说抵牾时并列异文、注明取舍理由——让读者保留重判的通道
翻检回写：写作的每一卷都以'读者将带着什么问题来翻'自问——镜子按使用姿势打磨
process_en: Set the admission question first: write down 'what question of governance this record answers' — material off-topic never enters the database
Annals as skeleton: press all events onto one timeline; secure 'order succeeds order' before interpretation — a causality with disordered sequence is not admitted
Kaoyi preserves truth: when accounts clash, set the variants side by side and note why one was chosen — keep the reader's channel to re-judge open
Write for retrieval: ask of every scroll 'with what question will the reader open it' — polish the mirror by the posture of use
representative_cases_zh: 《通鉴》进书表：全书 294 卷 19 年成书，'遍阅旧史，旁采小说'后自削至'关兴衰系休戚'者——收录标准的自律先于写作
赤壁之战的写法：以《汉纪》年月为干，削去无涉治道的枝蔓——一场战役被写成'决策质量如何决定胜负'的案例
'臣光曰'的用法：史评只在治道关键处出现，全书仅二百余则——议论服务于检索，不喧宾夺主
representative_cases_en: The memorial of 1084: 294 scrolls in nineteen years, 'having read all the old histories and gleaned the minor records', cut down to what bears on rise-and-fall — self-discipline of admission preceded writing
The Red Cliffs entry: the Han chronology as spine, trimming all twigs remote from the way of governance — a battle written as a case of how decision quality decides victory
Use of 'Your servant Guang says': commentary appears only at pivotal points of governance, barely two hundred in the whole book — argument serves retrieval, never upstages it
modern_applications_zh: 企业知识库建设：内部复盘库按'决策问题'索引而非按部门归档——'善可为法、恶可为戒'才入库
决策支持：重大决策前先检索'同类情境的历史案例'——把组织史变成决策数据库
研究写作：争议处并列各家证据并注明取舍——不替读者做黑箱判断
modern_applications_en: Build the corporate knowledge base indexed by decision question, not by department — only 'good as model, evil as warning' enters
Decision support: before a major call, retrieve 'historical cases of the same situation' — turn organisational history into a decision database
Research writing: where accounts conflict, set out each party's evidence and note the choice — never hand the reader a black-box verdict

modes.domain_zh: 认识论/史料互斥时公开证据链、注明取舍理由，把'怎么知道的'与'知道了什么'一起交给读者
modes.domain_en: Epistemology / when sources conflict, expose the chain of evidence and justify the choice, handing the reader both 'what is known' and 'how it is known'
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/修《通鉴》长编时司马光遇到'事同文异'的困境：同一场战役，诸书年月不同、胜负互异、数字悬殊；他的解法是发明'考异'体例——'参考群书，评其同异，疑则并存'：第一层把异文全部列出（证据公开），第二层给出取舍及理由（判断透明），第三层'事同文异者但举一'而重要歧义保留（噪音剔除、信号保留）；这实质上是史学的可复现性标准：另一个史家拿着同样的异文清单，能检验他的取舍是否成立；在'实录即真理'的时代，他把'史'从抄录重新定义为'在竞争性证据间做出可辩护的裁决'
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology: compiling the Mirror's long draft, Sima Guang faced 'the same event, divergent texts' — one battle with different dates in different books, opposite outcomes, wildly apart numbers; his answer was the invention of the kaoyi genre: 'compare the many books, weigh their agreements and differences, and where doubt remains, preserve both'; three layers — first, all variants listed (evidence exposed); second, the choice with its reason (judgment transparent); third, 'where texts differ but the event is one, cite one' while key divergences stay (noise culled, signal kept); this is in substance a reproducibility standard for history: another historian holding the same list of variants can test whether the adjudication stands; in an age when 'the veritable record was truth', he redefined history from transcription to 'a defensible ruling among competing evidence'
modes.source_chapter: 《资治通鉴考异》三十卷；司马光《答范梦得》论修书三步法
modes.key_quote_zh: 事同文异者，但举其一；抵牾之甚者，两存其说——我判的每个案子，都留给你重判的卷宗。
modes.key_quote_en: Where texts differ but the event is one, cite one; where they clash outright, keep both accounts — every case I judge leaves you the file to judge again.
key_concepts: 证据公开 evidence on the table（异文全部列示——不藏对己不利的说法）
evidence on the table (all variants listed — no account unfavourable to the ruling is hidden)
判断透明 transparent adjudication（取舍必附理由——裁决可被检验而非仅可被相信）
transparent adjudication (every choice carries its reason — a ruling to be tested, not merely believed)
疑则并存 suspending the undecidable（裁决不了的两说并录——诚实标记认识的边界）
suspending the undecidable (where no ruling is possible, both accounts stand — the boundary of knowledge honestly marked)
process_zh: 汇集异文：把同一事实的所有记载集中对齐——先让矛盾可见，再谈裁决
三步筛法：'事同文异者但举一，事异文同者并存之，抵牾之甚者注其取舍'——按矛盾性质分流处理
注明理由：取舍不写'据某某'完事，要写'为什么某某更可信'——把方法论说出口
留卷宗：关键歧义以考异卷保存原文——后人可以翻案，翻案有据
process_en: Assemble the variants: gather all accounts of the same fact and align them — make the contradiction visible before ruling
The three-step sieve: 'same event, different texts — cite one; different events, same text — keep both; outright clash — note the choice' — route by the nature of the contradiction
State the reason: never close with 'per such-and-such' alone — write 'why such-and-such is more credible'; say the methodology aloud
Keep the file: key divergences preserved in the kaoyi scrolls — later hands may overturn the ruling, and the grounds are there
representative_cases_zh: 淝水之战兵力考：诸书'百万''八十七万'互异，考异并列《晋书》《十六国春秋》诸说并注明从《晋书》之由——百万神话被降格为'一家之辞'
玄武门之变的史料处理：《实录》经太宗朝改窜，司马光在《通鉴》中注出史料层累的痕迹——连胜利者的官方史也不照单全收
考异三十卷传世：使后世能对《通鉴》逐条复核——清代考据学全程以此为方法起点
representative_cases_en: The Fei River troop count: 'one million' against 'eighty-seven thousand' across books; the kaoyi sets the Jin History beside the Sixteen Kingdoms annals and notes why the former prevails — the million myth demoted to 'one school's word'

Handling the Xuanwu Gate sources: the Veritable Records had been revised under Taizong's reign; Guang notes in the Mirror the strata of tampering — even the victors' official history is not swallowed whole
Thirty kaoyi scrolls survive: the Mirror can be audited clause by clause — Qing evidential scholarship began precisely from this method
modern_applications_zh: 尽职调查：把'各来源对同一事实的说法差异'做成对照表再下结论——先公开矛盾再裁决
数据治理：模型取舍记录'为什么用 A 源弃 B 源'——判断透明可复核
学术评审：重要争议在正文注明'异说并存'，不强行定于一尊——诚实标注不确定性
modern_applications_en: Due diligence: build a comparison table of how sources disagree on the same fact before concluding — expose the contradiction, then rule
Data governance: record in the model 'why source A was used and B dropped' — adjudication transparent and auditable
Peer review: note 'variant views coexist' in the text for live disputes — honesty about uncertainty beats false consensus

兰克（对照：'如实直书'的德国史学以另一种方式抵达同一纪律）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/把碎片化记录压进统一时间轴，先恢复'先后'再谈'因果'
modes.domain_en: Methodology / compressing fragmentary records onto one unified timeline, restoring sequence before attempting cause
modes.definition_zh: 方法论/纪传体以人为纲，一人一传、事件被拆散在几十篇传里——司马光认为这'不能使先后有伦'：读者看见结果却重建不出过程；他改以时间为纲：'左氏之法'——同一时期所有线索（政治、军事、财政、灾异）被压到同一条年月轴上，大事发生时读者能看到'同一时间系统里其他变量在做什么'；这是把数据库从'按人检索'改成'按时检索'的重构，本质是承认因果判断的前提是时序还原：不知道先后，一切'因为所以'都是事后编造；他为此定了修书工序：先做丛目（所有史料按年月排），再修长编（宁失于繁、毋失于略），最后删成定稿——三道工序层层压缩，时序骨架始终不动
modes.definition_en: Methodology: the biographical format takes the person as its spine, one life per chapter, events shredded across dozens of chapters — Sima Guang held this 'cannot give order to before and after': the reader sees outcomes but cannot rebuild the process; he took time as the spine instead — the method of Zuo Qiuming — pressing every thread of a period (politics, war, finance, portents) onto one dated axis, so that when a great event occurs the reader sees what the other variables of the same system were doing; this is the re-engineering of the archive from retrieval by person to retrieval by time, resting on one admission: causal judgment presupposes restored sequence — ignorant of the order, every 'because' is invented after the fact; hence his workshop order: first the catalogue (all sources arranged by date), then the long draft ('rather too full than too thin'), finally the fair copy — three passes compressing layer by layer, the chronological skeleton never moved
modes.source_chapter: 《资治通鉴》体例自述；司马光《与范内翰论修书帖》'先做丛目、长编'
modes.key_quote_zh: 纪传之体，一人之事散在数十年间——欲知其详，必先使先后有伦。
modes.key_quote_en: In the biographical form one man's deeds lie scattered across decades — to know the matter, first give order to before and after.
key_concepts: 时序先于因果 sequence before cause（先后不明的因果一律存疑——时间轴是因果的地基）
sequence before cause (causality with unknown order is held in doubt — the timeline is the foundation of the because)
多线同轴 many threads, one axis（政治军事财政灾异压到同一年月轴——系统视角由此产生）
many threads, one axis (politics, war, finance, omens pressed onto the same dated axis — the systemic view is born here)
宁繁毋略 fuller over thinner（长编阶段宁失于繁——压缩可以做两次，漏掉不能重来）
fuller over thinner (at long-draft stage err on abundance — compression can be done twice; an omission cannot be redone)
process_zh: 先建时间轴：给研究问题画一条从起点到终点的年月轴——所有材料先挂轴再分类
按年归档：跨主体的事件全部按发生时点挂进同一轴——不许按'谁的事'拆散
宁繁毋略：第一遍穷尽材料宁可过载——删减损失小，漏采不可逆
压缩成稿：定稿只留'关兴衰系休戚'者——但时间轴上的位置一个不许丢
process_en: Draw the timeline first: for the research question, one dated axis from start to end — all materials hang on the axis before any classification
Archive by date: cross-actor events enter by time of occurrence — never shred by 'whose affair'
Fuller over thinner: the first pass exhausts material even into overload — losing in culling is small; missing in gathering is irreversible
Compress to the fair copy: keep only what bears on rise-and-fall — but not one position on the axis may be lost
representative_cases_zh: 《通鉴》对安史之乱的整叙：把节度使设置（710s）、府兵崩坏（740s）、宰相更迭、边镇战事压进同一条轴——'安史之乱为何发生'变成可沿时间轴回溯的结构问题
王安石变法在《通鉴》末卷的处理：新法条目、朝堂争论、地方执行同时并陈——同一年的政策与反弹同页可见
修书工序实证：范祖禹等三大助手分任丛目长编，司马光定稿'削其冗长'——从 692 卷长编削成 294 卷，时序零错位
representative_cases_en: The Mirror's integration of the An Lushan rebellion: jiedushi appointments (710s), the collapse of the militia (740s), chancellors' turnover and frontier wars pressed onto one axis — 'why the rebellion happened' becomes a structural question traceable along the timeline
Wang Anshi's reforms in the final scrolls: statute items, court debate and local execution side by side — in the same year, policy and backlash share one page
The workshop proven: three assistants divided catalogue and long draft, Guang's fair copy 'cut the overgrowth' — from a long draft of 692 scrolls to 294, zero dislocation of sequence
modern_applications_zh: 项目复盘：先还原完整时间线再谈根因——把邮件/工单/会议记录全部按时间戳挂轴
事故分析：多系统日志统一时区对齐后再找因果链——时序错位导致的假因果要首先排除
企业史整理：按'年'而非按'部门/人物'编纂大事记——跨部门因果才看得见
modern_applications_en: Project post-mortem: restore the complete timeline before root cause — hang every email, ticket and meeting note on the axis by timestamp
Incident analysis: unify time zones across system logs before tracing causal chains — false causality from clock skew must be excluded first
Corporate history: compile chronicles by year, not by department or person — only then do cross-functional causes become visible
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
左丘明（思想源流：《左传》编年记事的直系先祖）
布罗代尔（对照：长时段/事件史分层——现代史学对'时间'的又一次重构）

modes.domain_zh: 决策方法论/危机瞬间的最优解常在常规选项之外——敢于'砸破系统的一部分'来拯救系统整体
modes.domain_en: Decision methodology / the best move in a crisis often lies outside the menu of normal options — dare to smash part of the system to save the whole
modes.definition_zh: 决策方法论/七岁儿童司马光遇同伴坠入水瓮：同伴们或跑或哭，都在'从瓮口救人'这个默认选项里打转；他砸破瓮，水泄人出——把目标从'把人从瓮里弄出来'重定义为'让人和水分离'，约束条件就翻了个面；这是典型的约束翻转：默认选项带着隐含约束'瓮不可破坏'，而危机恰恰是重新审视约束的时刻——瓮是财产，孩子是生命，两害相权当场可断；破瓮法不是鲁莽，而是'在系统失灵时敢于把系统的某个部件当耗材'：砸碎的是价值低于所救之物的东西，且动作必须当场完成、不可等待——危机会把'最优解'的存在窗口关得很窄
modes.definition_en: Decision methodology: a seven-year-old Sima Guang saw a companion fall into a water jar; the other children ran or wept, all circling inside the default option 'get him out through the mouth'; he smashed the jar and the water left with the boy out — redefining the goal from 'get the person out of the jar' to 'separate the person from the water', and the constraint flipped; this is the classic constraint flip: the default carries the implicit constraint 'the jar must not be destroyed', and crisis is precisely the moment to re-examine constraints — the jar is property, the child is life, and the lesser evil can be weighed on the spot; smashing the jar is not recklessness but the nerve to treat a component of a failing system as consumable: what is smashed is worth less than what is saved, and the act must complete in the moment — crisis closes the window in which the best move exists
modes.source_chapter: 《宋史·司马光传》'群儿戏于庭，一儿登瓮，足跌没水中'；邵伯温《邵氏闻见录》
modes.key_quote_zh: 瓮碎了可以再买，人没了不能再来——危机时刻先问：我死守的那个约束，还值钱吗？
modes.key_quote_en: A broken jar can be bought again; a lost child cannot — in crisis, first ask: the constraint I hold so fast, is it still worth anything?
key_concepts: 约束翻转 constraint flip（把'不可破坏的瓮'重新定价——默认约束是选项不是公理）
constraint flip (reprice the 'unbreakable jar' — the default constraint is an option, not an axiom)
目标重述 goal restatement（从'出瓮'改为'人水分离'——换目标比换手段更彻底）
goal restatement (from 'out of the jar' to 'separate person and water' — changing the goal beats changing the means)
窗口狭窄 the narrow window（危机最优解存在时间极短——当场可断的判断力是核心资产）
the narrow window (the best move lives only moments — on-the-spot decisiveness is the core asset)
process_zh: 危机来临先列死守的约束：把'默认不可动'的东西明示出来——问它为什么不可动、现在还成立吗
重述目标：把'怎么做成'改成'本质要达成什么'——手段层面的死局在目标层面常常有活路
两害相权当场断：比较'破坏约束的代价'与'等待的代价'——后者更高时立即行动
接受损失闭环：砸了就认——破瓮的代价在事前评估、当场承受、事后不追悔
process_en: On crisis, list the constraints you hold sacred: make explicit what 'by default cannot move' — ask why, and whether it still holds
Restate the goal: from 'how to do it' to 'what essentially must be achieved' — dead ends at the means level often open at the goal level
Weigh the two evils on the spot: the cost of breaking the constraint against the cost of waiting — when waiting costs more, act now
Close the loop of loss: if you smash it, own it — the jar's price is assessed beforehand, borne on the spot, never mourned after
representative_cases_zh: 破瓮救友 (1026 前后)：京洛间画以为图——七岁儿童的动作被当作决策教材流传千年
《通鉴》收录的同类决断：'当机立断'案例被反复凸显（如霍光废昌邑王的二十七天决策）——编者本人显然把'当场可断'当成治道核心能力
反对王安石新法的节奏：司马光并非一味拖延，'免役法之害较青苗为轻则缓争，青苗之害立见则死争'——争什么、让什么也是两害相权的当下决断
representative_cases_en: Smashing the jar (c. 1026): painted and circulated in the capital — a seven-year-old's act became a decision textbook for a millennium

Kindred rulings collected in the Mirror: decisive-on-the-spot cases recur (Huo Guang's deposal of the King of Changyi in twenty-seven days) — the compiler plainly rated on-the-spot judgment a core capacity of governance

The rhythm of opposing the New Policies: not stalling all along — 'where the corvée-exemption law harms less, contest slowly; where the Green Sprouts harm shows at once, contest to the death' — what to fight and what to yield is itself a two-evils judgment made in the present
modern_applications_zh: 应急预案：为关键流程预设'允许砸破的瓮'清单——哪些资产可弃、谁有权当场决定
产品设计：死锁场景设置'人工破瓮'按钮——宁可付出数据一致性代价也要先恢复可用
个人决策：被'沉没成本/面子/流程'困住时问'我死守的约束还值钱吗'——当场重定价
modern_applications_en: Contingency plans: pre-list 'jars allowed to smash' for critical processes — which assets may be abandoned, who may decide on the spot
Product design: a manual 'break-the-jar' button for deadlock scenarios — pay the consistency price to restore availability first
Personal decisions: trapped by sunk cost, face or procedure, ask 'is the constraint I hold still worth it' — reprice on the spot
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
曹冲（对照：同为儿童天才决断——称象是化整为零，破瓮是舍整取要）
本田宗一郎（同道：曼岛宣战同为'把死守的东西重新定价'的危机决断）

modes.domain_zh: 个人管理方法论/用'不适用的舒适'设计自制的纪律装置，把长期工程的节奏交给物而非意志
modes.domain_en: Personal-management methodology / designing self-made discipline devices out of 'uncomfortable comforts', committing the rhythm of a long undertaking to things rather than willpower
modes.definition_zh: 个人管理方法论/编《通鉴》十九年，司马光睡的是一段圆木——'警枕'：稍一沉睡翻身，枕头滚动即醒，起身继续；他不依赖意志力而依赖装置设计：把'不能久睡'外化成一个会自己滚走的木头，同时以'日力不足，继之以夜'的日程把工程切成可日结的最小单元（每三天删一卷长编），并以'圆木'这类自造的'不适'对冲人性中'舒适即懈怠'的默认走向；配套的是身体账本：他自述'平生所为，未尝有不可对人言者'的背后是同样纪律的日常版——警枕法的本质是把'长期主义的成本'从道德努力转译为工程设计：意志靠不住，就让物体替你执法
modes.definition_en: Personal-management methodology: through the nineteen years of the Mirror Sima Guang slept on a round log — the 'warning pillow': sink a little too deep, turn over, and the log rolls the sleeper awake to rise and continue; he did not rely on willpower but on device design — externalising 'must not oversleep' into a piece of wood that rolls away by itself; in parallel he sliced the undertaking into daily-closable units ('each three days, one scroll of the long draft'), working nights when the day ran out; and the log is one of several self-made discomforts hedging the human default that comfort breeds slack — behind his boast 'in all my life nothing I could not say to another's face' stands the same discipline in its daily edition; the essence of the log-pillow method is translating the cost of long-termism from moral effort into engineering design: willpower cannot be trusted, so let objects enforce the law for you
modes.source_chapter: 马永卿《元城语录》记'圆木为警枕'；司马光《进资治通鉴表》'日力不足，继之以夜'
modes.key_quote_zh: 臣之精力，尽于此书——不是意志硬撑十九年，是一根木头逼了十九年。
modes.key_quote_en: Whatever strength your servant has was spent on this book — not nineteen years of willpower, but nineteen years of one log pressing him on.
key_concepts: 装置替代意志 device over willpower（纪律写成物——木头不会原谅'再睡五分钟'）
device over willpower (discipline written as an object — the log never forgives 'five more minutes')
日结切片 daily-closable slices（每三天一卷的最小闭环——长期工程不靠士气靠节奏）
daily-closable slices (one scroll per three days — long projects run on cadence, not morale)
自造不适 engineered discomfort（主动引入'不便'对冲懈怠——舒适默认即风险默认）
engineered discomfort (imported inconvenience hedges slack — the comfort default is the risk default)
process_zh: 把目标切成日结单元：长工程必须每天有一个'完成'——节奏可见，士气不靠激情
为最薄弱环节造装置：找出自己最守不住的那一环（贪睡/刷手机/超支），做成物理或软件的'自动执法器'
主动加不适：把舒适度调到'能工作但懒得享受'——躺椅上写不出通鉴
以账本代反省：进度用可数的卷数/页数计量——不问'今天状态如何'，只问'今天交了几卷'
process_en: Slice the goal into daily-closable units: a long project must finish something every day — visible cadence, morale without passion
Build a device for your weakest link: the ring you cannot hold (oversleeping, the phone, overspend) becomes a physical or software auto-enforcer
Import discomfort deliberately: tune comfort to 'workable but too awkward to enjoy' — no Comprehensive Mirror was written in a lounger
Ledger over introspection: measure progress in countable scrolls or pages — ask not 'how do I feel today' but 'how many scrolls did I deliver today'
representative_cases_zh: 圆木警枕：终身用之——洛阳独乐园的书房里那截木头是十九年工程的'执法官'
'每三日删一卷'的节奏：自比于'木石'的工作量管理——助手刘恕刘攽范祖禹的长编按期供给全靠这个节拍器
对子弟的传法：他写《家范》训'由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难'——把警枕的原理讲成家规，装置升级为制度
representative_cases_en: The log pillow, used all his life: in the Luoyang study that piece of wood was the 'law officer' of the nineteen-year undertaking
The rhythm of 'one scroll cut per three days': self-measured like timber and stone; that assistants Liu Shu, Liu Ban and Fan Zuyu delivered long drafts on time owed everything to this metronome

The method handed down: in the Family Models he taught 'from thrift to luxury is easy; from luxury to thrift is hard' — the log's principle spoken as family rule, the device upgraded into an institution
modern_applications_zh: 个人效率：用物理手段（手机保险盒/定时断网）替代'自制力'——纪律交给装置
长项目管理：周/日粒度的可数交付物+公开进度账——不依赖灵感与状态
习惯设计：'让好行为顺手、让坏行为多一步'——自造不适工程学
modern_applications_en: Personal efficiency: physical means (phone lockbox, scheduled disconnection) in place of 'self-control' — give discipline to a device
Long projects: countable deliverables at day/week granularity plus a public progress ledger — no reliance on inspiration
Habit design: 'make the good act frictionless, the bad act one step harder' — the engineering of manufactured discomfort

富兰克林（同道：'十三美德'记分册——同为把德性翻译成可数账目的装置派）
柳比歇夫（对照：时间统计法——以记录代替枕头，异曲同工）

modes.domain_zh: 改革方法论/改革如同修屋——'必先自坏始'：承认屋已坏、分次换梁、住人不辍，拒绝推倒重来
modes.domain_en: Reform methodology / reform is house repair — 'it must begin from what has rotted': admit the rot, replace beams in instalments, keep the household living in it, and refuse demolition
modes.definition_zh: 改革方法论/司马光的政治哲学在《迩英阁读〈资治通鉴〉》对神宗讲得明白：'治天下譬如居室，敝则修之，非大坏不更造也'——屋子破了就修，不到彻底塌了不推倒重建；因为'更造'意味着'家室俱焚'：拆迁期间住人无所有，成本由全体承担而收益遥不可期；修屋法的操作要点：其一'必先自坏始'——从确实坏掉的部分动工（他反对新法不是反对改革本身，而是反对'屋未大坏而更造'）；其二分次换梁——一次换一根，屋内人照常生活（'三次论青苗'都是就法修法而非全盘推翻）；其三尊重'居人'——改革承受者（百姓与官僚）的日常运转不能为工程让路；这是与'推倒重来'彻底对立的改革时间观：好制度是攒出来的，不是换出来的
modes.definition_en: Reform methodology: Sima Guang's political philosophy he put plainly to Shenzong in the Reading of the Mirror at Er'ying Pavilion: 'to govern the realm is like dwelling in a house — when it rots, repair it; never rebuild until it is wholly ruined'; for rebuilding means the household burns with it: during demolition the dwellers have nothing, the cost is borne by all and the benefit lies far beyond sight; the operating points of house-repair: first, 'begin from what has indeed rotted' — he opposed the New Policies not reform itself but 'rebuilding a house not yet ruined'; second, beams replaced in instalments — one beam at a time, the household living on (his three memorials on the Green Sprouts law each mended that law, none toppled the whole); third, respect for the dwellers — the daily running of the reformed (people and officials) must not yield way to the works; a theory of reform-time squarely against demolition: good institutions are accumulated, not swapped
modes.source_chapter: 《宋史·司马光传》'治天下譬如居室'；司马光论新法诸疏
modes.key_quote_zh: 居室少有敝坏，则修之而已——大坏而更造，未得居其旧，先受其烦。
modes.key_quote_en: When the house rots a little, repair it — rebuild only when wholly ruined; before the new dwelling is ready you have already tasted all its trouble.
key_concepts: 大坏门槛 the ruin threshold（'非大坏不更造'——重造的成本门槛必须真的被越过）
the ruin threshold ('never rebuild until wholly ruined' — the cost gate of rebuilding must truly be crossed)
分次换梁 beams in instalments（一次一根、住人不辍——改革与运转并行而非互斥）
beams in instalments (one at a time, the household living on — reform and operation run in parallel, not in trade-off)
自坏始 begin from the rot（从确实坏掉处动工——诊断先于方案，别拿好墙开刀）
begin from the rot (start where it is truly broken — diagnosis precedes the plan; do not operate on a sound wall)
process_zh: 先做'坏屋诊断'：逐项评估制度哪些梁真坏了、哪些只是不喜欢——只对'坏'开工
设大坏门槛：明确'什么程度才值得推倒重来'——未过门槛一律进修理程序
分次换梁：把改革拆成独立可回滚的批次——每批落地后先看屋内人能否照常生活
住人优先：任何改革方案先回答'推行期间的日常谁来兜底'——运转中断本身是最大的成本
process_en: Diagnose the rotting house first: assess which beams are truly broken and which merely disliked — commence work only on the broken
Set the ruin threshold: define explicitly 'at what degree is demolition worth it' — below the gate, everything goes to the repair track
Beams in instalments: split reform into independently reversible batches — after each, first ask whether the household can live on
Dwellers first: every plan must answer 'who underwrites daily operations during the works' — interruption of operations is itself the greatest cost
representative_cases_zh: 元祐更化中的自我克制：司马光尽废新法常被讥'复辟'，但他同样反对尽逐新党——'修屋'逻辑里党人也只是屋内人
免役法之争的具体性：他的奏疏逐条讨论差役/免役的账目——争的是'这根梁怎么换'而非'该不该修屋'
《资治通鉴》对历代'更造'的记录偏好：王莽、隋炀帝的全面重构被写成系统性灾难——编年史本身就是修屋法的证据库
representative_cases_en: Self-restraint in the Yuanyou restoration: often mocked as 'restoration' for abolishing the New Policies wholesale, he yet opposed expelling the New Party root and branch — in house-repair logic, partisans are also dwellers
The particularity of the corvée debate: his memorials go through the accounts item by item — the dispute is 'how to swap this beam', not 'whether to repair the house'
The Mirror's record of past 'rebuildings': the wholesale reconstructions of Wang Mang and the Sui Yangdi written as systemic catastrophe — the chronicle itself is the evidence base of house-repair
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革：把变革拆成可回滚批次、规定'业务不停摆'红线——拒绝'推倒重构'式大爆炸
技术债治理：只重构'真坏'的模块、为重写设'大坏门槛'——不喜欢不等于要推倒
公共政策：改革期先设计'过渡期兜底'——承受者的日常运转优先于工程进度
modern_applications_en: Organisational change: split into reversible batches with a 'business never stops' red line — refuse the big-bang rewrite
Technical debt: refactor only modules truly broken; set a 'ruin threshold' for rewrites — disliked is not demolished
Public policy: design the transition backstop before the reform — the reformed's daily operations outrank the construction schedule
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
埃德蒙·伯克（对照：法国大革命批判中的同一'渐进 vs 重构'哲学）
黄宗羲（对照：'治法优先'主张制度重设——两种改革时间观的对峙）

modes.domain_zh: 政治哲学/以'名'与'实'的核对为治理首务——礼治的本质是让头衔、等级与实际权力长期对齐
modes.domain_en: Political philosophy / the first duty of governance is auditing name against reality — ritual rule is the long alignment of titles, ranks and actual power
modes.definition_zh: 政治哲学方法论/《通鉴》开篇不写三家分晋的战争而写'天子之职莫大于礼'：周威烈王承认韩赵魏为诸侯那一刻，晋国大夫在实力上早已是诸侯——'天子既不能序，是自坏其纲纪'；司马光的诊断是：名分是权力的操作系统，名实错位在先、秩序崩坏在后——不是三家灭了晋，是'名'先死、'实'随后；由此得出治理第一律：天子之职莫大于礼，礼莫大于分，分莫大于名——守住'名实相副'比打赢任何一场战争都重要，因为战争输一场尚可再战，名一乱则人人得以自封；他甚至为此辩护'名'的价值高于'实'的表面不匹配：齐桓晋文强大而不敢代周，正是'名'在约束'实'——礼治不是虚伪，是用低成本符号系统锁住高成本暴力博弈
modes.definition_en: Political-philosophy methodology: the Comprehensive Mirror opens not with the wars of the partition of Jin but with 'the Son of Heaven's greatest duty is ritual': the moment King Weilie of Zhou recognised the three houses as marquises, the ministers of Jin had long been marquises in power — 'the Son of Heaven, unable to preserve the order, broke his own frame'; Guang's diagnosis: name-and-rank is the operating system of power; misalignment precedes collapse — the three houses did not destroy Jin; the 'name' died first and the 'reality' followed; hence the first law of governance: the Son of Heaven's greatest duty is ritual, ritual's greatest is division, division's greatest is name; guarding the fit of name to reality outranks winning any war — a war lost can be refought, but once names are scrambled, everyone may crown himself; he even defended the worth of 'name' above the surface mismatch of 'reality': that Huan of Qi and Wen of Jin, powerful, dared not supplant Zhou was 'name' constraining 'reality' — ritual rule is not hypocrisy but a low-cost symbol system locking down a high-cost contest of violence
modes.source_chapter: 《资治通鉴》卷一'臣光曰'开篇论名分；周威烈王二十三年 (前 403) 三家分晋
modes.key_quote_zh: 天子之职莫大于礼，礼莫大于分，分莫大于名——不是三家灭了晋，是'名'先死了。
modes.key_quote_en: The Son of Heaven's greatest duty is ritual; ritual's greatest is division; division's greatest is name — the three houses did not destroy Jin; the name died first.
key_concepts: 名先于乱 name precedes collapse（名实错位是秩序崩坏的前置变量——监控名分即监控风险）
name precedes collapse (name-reality misalignment is the leading variable of collapse — watch the names, watch the risk)
礼的操作系统 ritual as OS（名分是权力的寻址系统——符号成本换暴力成本）
ritual as OS (name-and-rank is the addressing system of power — symbol cost paid for violence cost saved)
自坏纲纪 the self-broken frame（最大的危险来自授权者自己越过名分——默认守护者即最大风险源）
the self-broken frame (the gravest danger is the authoriser crossing the line — the default guardian is the largest risk source)
process_zh: 建立名实台账：把每个头衔/职级对应的实际权力写清楚——定期核对'名'与'实'的偏差
把名分当红线：任何越级授权、临时扩权都要在事后归还或正式追认——'暂时例外'是名实错位的主要入口
监控'名先死'信号：上级开始习惯性绕过名分办事，就是纲纪自坏的先兆——此时纠正成本最低
以名驭实而非以实定名：给强力者名分要格外谨慎——名是最后防线，授出即难收回
process_en: Build a name-reality ledger: write down the actual power each title and rank carries — audit the drift of name against reality on schedule
Treat names as red lines: every out-of-rank delegation and temporary enlargement must be returned or formally ratified after the fact — the 'temporary exception' is the main door of misalignment
Watch the 'name dying first' signal: when superiors habitually bypass rank to get things done, the frame is breaking from within — cheapest to correct now
Govern reality by name, not name by reality: be extra careful conferring names on the strong — the name is the last line of defence, and once given is hard to take back
representative_cases_zh: 《通鉴》开篇断代选择：不从'三家分晋实权已成'写起，而从'周天子承认'写起——把叙事起点放在'名'被授出的那一刻，是方法论宣言
齐桓晋文案例：'以名约束实'的正例——霸主打着尊王旗号行扩张之实，名分约束下的扩张远弱于无名的兼并
对新法的批评方式：他攻击王安石'名为理财、实为聚敛'——名实相稽是攻击政敌的核心武器，可见其认识论地位
representative_cases_en: The Mirror's choice of opening: not from 'the three houses already held the power of Jin' but from 'the Son of Heaven's recognition' — placing the narrative's start at the moment the name was conferred is itself a methodological manifesto
Huan of Qi and Wen of Jin: the positive case of name constraining reality — expansion under the banner of honouring the king stayed far milder than nameless annexation
The form of his attack on the New Policies: Wang Anshi 'named wealth-management, practised wealth-plunder' — name-reality audit as the core weapon against rivals shows its epistemic rank
modern_applications_zh: 组织治理：职级/权限矩阵定期审计——'挂名总监''影子决策者'是纲纪自坏信号
授权管理：临时授权必须设归还日期——'名实相副'写进授权流程
品牌与合规：对外承诺（'名'）与实际能力（'实'）定期核对——过度承诺即自坏其名
modern_applications_en: Governance: regular audit of the title-authority matrix — 'titular directors' and 'shadow deciders' are the frame breaking from within
Delegation: every temporary mandate carries a return date — name-reality fit written into the delegation workflow
Brand and compliance: audit external promises (name) against actual capability (reality) — overpromising is smashing your own name
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
孔子（思想源流：'正名'传统的直系继承人——必也正名乎）
韩非（对照：同样看到名实关系，法家主张'循名责实'的惩罚版）

modes.domain_zh: 伦理方法论/把俭朴设为德性的地基与欲望的预算约束——'由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难'作为制度设计输入
modes.domain_en: Ethical methodology / setting frugality as the foundation of virtue and the budget constraint of desire — 'from thrift to luxury is easy, from luxury to thrift is hard' as an input to institutional design
modes.definition_zh: 伦理方法论/司马光《训俭示康》开篇即引'俭，德之共也；侈，恶之大也'：他的论证不是道德说教而是机制分析——'由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难'：欲望的支出曲线只升不降，所以俭朴是对未来的自己保留谈判筹码；'有德者皆由俭来'的因果链是：俭则寡欲，寡欲则不被外物役使，不被役使才能'直道而行'——贪欲是权力寻租的入口，俭是廉洁的工程学基础而非道德装饰；他把这条原理写进家规（儿子司马康的名与实都被他反复审计：'食不敢常有肉，衣不敢纯有帛'），也用于政治鉴别：对王安石的'理财'他判为'用度奢则赋敛重'——个人伦理与国家财政在'俭'字上打通
modes.definition_en: Ethical methodology: the Family Models for Kang opens citing 'thrift is the common ground of virtue; extravagance the chief of evils'; his argument is mechanism, not preaching — 'from thrift to luxury is easy; from luxury to thrift is hard': the expenditure curve of desire rises only, so thrift is the negotiating chip kept for one's future self; the causal chain of 'the virtuous all come from thrift': thrift yields few desires, few desires leave one unenslaved by things, and only the unenslaved can 'walk the straight way' — greed is the entry of rent-seeking, and thrift is the engineering basis of integrity, not its ornament; he wrote the principle into family rule (auditing his son Kang's name against reality again and again: 'dare not always have meat to eat, dare not have only silk to wear'), and applied it to political discernment: Wang Anshi's 'wealth management' he judged 'when spending is luxurious, exactions grow heavy' — personal ethics and state finance joined at the single word thrift
modes.source_chapter: 司马光《训俭示康》；'平生所为未尝有不可对人言者'自述
modes.key_quote_zh: 由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难——俭不是省钱，是给未来的自己留谈判筹码。
modes.key_quote_en: From thrift to luxury is easy; from luxury to thrift is hard — thrift is not scrimping; it is the bargaining chip saved for your future self.
key_concepts: 欲望棘轮 the desire ratchet（支出只升不降——俭是对冲棘轮的预埋约束）
the desire ratchet (spending rises only — thrift is the pre-set constraint hedging the ratchet)
俭-直因果链 thrift-to-integrity chain（寡欲→不被物役→直道而行——廉洁的工程学基础）
the thrift-to-integrity chain (few desires → unenslaved by things → the straight way — the engineering basis of integrity)
以身垂范 model by person（对儿子逐项审计'食肉/衣帛'——家规的执行者是家长自己的账本）
model by person (auditing his son's meat and silk item by item — the enforcer of family rule is the parent's own ledger)
process_zh: 把俭设为默认档：标准配置按'够用'定——升级需要理由，降级随时可行
审计欲望支出曲线：定期检视哪些消费已经'下不来了'——棘轮转过的每一格都要警惕
以'不可对人言'为检验：任何开销/行为，设想公示于最严苛者面前的反应——过不了公示就撤回
家规即制度：把个人纪律写成家庭/组织规则并以自己为第一执行对象——示范先于要求
process_en: Set thrift as the default tier: standard configuration sized to 'sufficient' — upgrades need reasons, downgrades stay possible at any time
Audit the desire-spend curve: check periodically which consumptions can no longer come down — every notch the ratchet has turned is a warning
The 'sayable to another's face' test: imagine every expense and act displayed before the harshest observer — what fails the display is withdrawn
Family rule as institution: write personal discipline into household or organisational rules, enforcing it first on oneself — model precedes demand
representative_cases_zh: 《训俭示康》的写作场景：面对儿子赴任前的排场风险，他把个人伦理写成可传的制度文本——此文成为后世家训范式
洛阳独乐园的'陋'：司马光居洛十五年园仅'聚书五千卷'——同时代高官园林的奢靡反衬其'识者多其廉'的公信力资本
临终遗表'无以时政为言'：一生俭直的终局验证——'平生所为未尝有不可对人言者'到死不作一次例外
representative_cases_en: The scene of writing for Kang: facing the pageantry risk of his son's first post, he turned personal ethics into a transmissible institutional text — the pattern of later family instructions

The 'plainness' of the Garden of Solitude: fifteen years in Luoyang with a garden of 'five thousand scrolls of books' — against the luxury of contemporaries' estates, the public-trust capital of 'the discerning praised his integrity'

The deathbed memorial 'say nothing of current policy': the final verification of a life of thrift and straightness — 'nothing in my life unsayable to another's face' held without one exception to the end
modern_applications_zh: 个人财务：设'由奢入俭'演练——定期用'降级一周'测试生活标准的可逆性
组织廉洁：把'可公示测试'写进报销与礼品制度——过不了公示的支出不存在
家风建设：家规以家长自我审计开头——训俭先训己
modern_applications_en: Personal finance: rehearse 'from luxury to thrift' — a periodic downgrade week to test the reversibility of your standard
Organisational integrity: write the 'displayable test' into expenses and gifts — spending that fails public display does not exist
Family culture: open the family rule with the parent's own audit — teach thrift by being thrifted first
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
墨子（思想源流：'节用'传统的更早版本）
松下幸之助（对照：'水库式经营'——同样把个人/组织财务纪律当作经营的地基）

modes.domain_zh: 政治伦理/把'言责'设为不可让渡的天职——提前买好棺材进谏，死谏不是姿态而是预先声明的底线
modes.domain_en: Political ethics / the duty of speech as an untransferable vocation — buying one's coffin before remonstrating; dying for the word is not posture but a pre-declared bottom line
modes.definition_zh: 政治伦理方法论/仁宗死而无嗣时，司马光上疏立储——这是臣子最忌的话题，他自述'臣言此，自谓必死'并提前买好棺材；尽言法的结构有三：其一'言责与职守分离'——不管他担任什么职务，'言'是天职，宁可辞官不可缄默；其二'预先声明底线'——把最坏结果（死）提前接受并公示，压力从'敢不敢说'转为'说不说透'；其三'对事不对人的尽言'——他与王安石争新法数十疏全在法条层面，私下'光与介甫趣向虽殊，大归则同'的友谊不断；这使尽言区别于党争攻击：他反对的是'名实不符的术'，不是'与我不同的人'；尽言的风险管理是完整的：买棺材是风险接受，撤帘还政后拒枢密是风险退出——知道何时说透、也知道何时退出
modes.definition_en: Political-ethics methodology: when Renzong died without an heir, Sima Guang memorialised on naming a successor — the topic ministers most dreaded; he said of himself 'speaking this, I expect to die', and bought the coffin beforehand; the structure of speaking-wholly has three parts: first, the duty of speech separated from office — whatever post he held, 'speech' was the vocation; better to resign than to hold the tongue; second, the bottom line declared in advance — accepting and publicising the worst outcome (death) up front, so the question shifts from 'dare I speak' to 'have I spoken it fully'; third, speaking wholly against the matter, not the man — dozens of memorials against the New Policies stay at the level of statute, while privately 'Guang and Jiefu differ in bent but agree in destination', the friendship unbroken; this distinguishes speaking-wholly from partisan attack: he opposed the术 that failed the name-reality audit, not the person who differed from him; the risk management is complete: the coffin is risk acceptance, and declining the Privy Council after the dowager's withdrawal is risk exit — knowing when to speak fully and when to withdraw
modes.source_chapter: 司马光论立储诸疏；邵伯温《邵氏闻见录》'预买棺材'记；司马光《与王介甫书》
modes.key_quote_zh: 臣言此，自谓必死——话要说透，棺材先买好；但争的是法，不是人。
modes.key_quote_en: Speaking this, I expect to die — the words said to the full, the coffin bought in advance; yet what I contest is the law, not the man.
key_concepts: 言责分离 speech separate from office（'言'是天职不是职务附庸——宁可辞官不可缄默）
speech separate from office ('speech' is a vocation, not a job attachment — resign rather than fall silent)
底线前置 the pre-declared floor（接受最坏结果并公示——把勇气问题转化为表达质量问题）
the pre-declared floor (accept and publicise the worst outcome — converting courage into a question of articulation)
对事尽言 the matter, not the man（数十疏皆在法条、友谊不断——尽言与党争的分界线）
the matter, not the man (dozens of memorials on statute, friendship unbroken — the boundary between remonstrance and factional attack)
process_zh: 把'说'与'职位'解耦：进谏前先想清楚'我是否愿意为这句话丢掉这个职位'——愿意，则职位不再是缄默的理由
预先接受最坏结果并公示：把'说透的代价'明示出来——压力从敢不敢转为透不透
锁定'事'的层面：批评全部落在制度与法条——对人保持尊重，避免尽言滑向党争
设计退出机制：尽言失败后知道何时退场（拒高位、退居著书）——不把声望当权力续期
process_en: Decouple speech from position: before remonstrating, decide 'am I willing to lose this post for these words' — if yes, the post is no longer a reason for silence
Accept the worst outcome in advance and say so: the price of full speech made explicit — the question turns from daring to thoroughness
Lock the level of 'the matter': keep all criticism on institutions and statute — respect the person, keep remonstrance from sliding into faction war
Design the exit: after speaking-wholly fails, know when to withdraw (decline high office, retire to write) — never renew power with prestige
representative_cases_zh: 立储疏 (1061 前后)：仁宗无嗣是最危险的话题——他连上三疏并买棺待罪，最终促成濮议前的立储
《与王介甫书》三千言+《遗表》：批评新法'侵官、生事、征利、拒谏'条条指实——同时维持与王安石的私谊
辞枢密副使：反对新法的方式是拒绝在新法政府中任职——尽言者也守住'不在其位不谋其政'的另一面
representative_cases_en: The succession memorials (c. 1061): Renzong heirless was the most perilous topic — three memorials in a row and a coffin bought awaiting punishment, at last moving the naming of an heir

The three-thousand-word letter to Jiefu: the New Policies attacked item by item as 'usurping offices, stirring affairs, squeezing profit, refusing counsel' — while private friendship with Wang Anshi held
Declining the Privy Council: his way of opposing was refusing to serve inside the New-Policy government — the speaker-wholly also honours 'not planning where one holds no office'
modern_applications_zh: 组织沟通：设'尽言'机制——对重大风险先问'说透了吗'而非'说得体吗'
异议伦理：反对意见落在方案层面、保持对人尊重——尽言与倾轧的分界写进团队章程
职业风险：公开表达异议前自问'最坏结果我是否接受'——把勇气变成风险管理
modern_applications_en: Organisational communication: a speak-wholly mechanism — for major risks ask 'has it been said to the full', not 'was it diplomatic'
The ethics of dissent: objections stay at the level of the plan with respect for persons — the boundary against factionalism written into the team charter
Career risk: before speaking out, ask 'do I accept the worst outcome' — turning courage into risk management
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
魏征（思想源流：唐廷犯颜直谏的先行传统）
本田宗一郎（对照：'顶撞容让法'——接受者一方的同构制度）

modes.domain_zh: 传承方法论/政治失意时把全部筹码兑换成一部传世制度文本——退居不是等待，是把影响力从权力轴切到文本轴
modes.domain_en: Succession methodology / on political defeat, converting the whole stake into one transmissible institutional text — retreat is not waiting but switching influence from the power axis to the text axis
modes.definition_zh: 传承方法论/熙宁变法后司马光退居洛阳十五年，'专以书局为事'：他没有以在野之身继续政治缠斗，而是把全部政治经验兑换成《资治通鉴》——一部写给未来所有执政者的制度文本；屏居法的逻辑是：权力轴上的失败是短期的（政党轮替），文本轴上的发言是永久的；操作要点有三：其一'以书局为阵地'——在野期建立自己的生产系统（书局、助手、体例），把'等待'变成'生产'；其二'退而不失其守'——洛阳十五年他仍是天下士大夫的精神坐标，'士大夫之贤者皆称之'：在野声望是在朝影响力的期权；其三'终局兑现'——元祐更化时他只需拿着十九年攒下的文本权威进场，治国方案早已在《通鉴》的每一卷'臣光曰'里写好；这是中国古代最成功的'影响力资产重组'案例之一
modes.definition_en: Succession methodology: after the Xining reforms Sima Guang withdrew to Luoyang for fifteen years, 'giving himself wholly to the book office': rather than fighting politics from outside, he converted his entire political experience into the Comprehensive Mirror — an institutional text written for every ruler yet to come; the logic of retreat: defeat on the power axis is short-lived (parties alternate), speech on the text axis is permanent; three operating points: first, 'the book office as position' — during the out-of-power years build your own production system (office, assistants, format), turning 'waiting' into 'producing'; second, 'retired yet keeping one's post in spirit' — through fifteen years in Luoyang he remained the moral coordinate of the literati: 'the worthiest of the scholar-officials all named him'; out-of-power repute is the call option on in-power influence; third, 'the end-game cash-out' — entering the Yuanyou restoration he needed only bring nineteen years of textual authority; the programme of rule was already written in every scroll's 'Your servant Guang says'; one of ancient China's most successful 'restructurings of influence assets'
modes.source_chapter: 司马光退居洛阳与独乐园书局 (1071-1085)；《进资治通鉴表》
modes.key_quote_zh: 朝堂输掉的那十五年，我在书桌上赢回来了——权力的失败是暂时的，文本的发言是永久的。
modes.key_quote_en: The fifteen years lost at court I won back at the desk — defeat in power is temporary; speech in text is permanent.
key_concepts: 双轴转换 the two-axis switch（权力轴失败即切文本轴——影响力的资产重组而非贬值）
the two-axis switch (losing the power axis, switch to the text axis — a restructuring of influence, not its depreciation)
以生产代等待 production instead of waiting（在野期建书局立体例——等待期是生产期）
production instead of waiting (build the book office and format out of power — the waiting period is the producing period)
期权式声望 repute as call option（在野声望是在朝影响力的期权——到期按行权价兑现）
repute as call option (out-of-power repute is the call option on in-power influence — cashed at strike when the turn comes)
process_zh: 失意时先选轴：评估自己是继续在权力轴缠斗还是切到文本轴——多数经验在文本轴复利更高
建生产系统：退居期立'书局'（选题、团队、体例、节奏）——把等待变成有进度的生产
守住在野公信：退而不失其守——行为标准在野在朝一致，声望才会成为期权
预设兑现条件：文本完成度与时机成熟度对表——元祐更化时带着成品进场而非空手返乡
process_en: Choose the axis on defeat: keep fighting the power axis or switch to the text axis — most experience compounds higher on the text axis
Build the production system: in retreat, stand up the 'book office' (topic, team, format, cadence) — waiting becomes producing with progress
Keep the out-of-power credibility: retired yet keeping one's post — conduct identical in and out of office, or repute will never become an option
Pre-set the cash-out: match the text's completeness against the maturity of the hour — enter the turn with the finished work, never empty-handed
representative_cases_zh: 独乐园十五年 (1071-1085)：洛阳士人圈以司马光为精神领袖——苏轼等往来论学，声望反超在朝时期
《通鉴》进书 (1084)：神宗赐序、容许继续修书——政敌王安石政府默认了这部'反对派的百科全书'的价值
元祐更化 (1085-1086)：以太皇太后召入，年近七十携十九年文本权威执政——不满两年尽废新法，身后'家家有象'的朱子评价足见其文本的长尾
representative_cases_en: Fifteen years in the Garden of Solitude (1071-85): the Luoyang literati took him as spiritual leader — Su Shi and others came to debate learning, his repute outgrowing his years in office
Presenting the Mirror (1084): Shenzong's preface and permission to continue — the rival government of Wang Anshi tacitly accepted the worth of this 'opposition's encyclopaedia'

The Yuanyou restoration (1085-86): summoned by the grand dowager near seventy, governing with nineteen years of textual authority — within two years the New Policies abolished; Zhu Xi's later verdict 'every household had its likeness' shows the long tail of the text
modern_applications_zh: 职业低谷：被边缘化时把行业经验写成方法论/开源/书——影响力切到文本轴
组织知识传承：核心人物退出决策层前先完成'制度文本化'——以文字而非口传交接
个人品牌：在野期的持续产出是在朝机会的期权——声望要靠'退而不失其守'来保值
modern_applications_en: Career trough: when sidelined, write the industry experience into methods, open source, books — switch influence to the text axis
Knowledge succession: before a key person leaves the decision layer, complete the 'textualisation of institutions' — hand over by writing, not by word of mouth
Personal brand: sustained output out of power is the call option on in-power chances — repute keeps its value only through 'retired yet keeping one's post'
representative_figures: 司马光（核心）
孔子（思想源流：'退而修诗书'——失位著述传统的开创者）
松下幸之助（对照：'晚岁立塾法'——以办学/著述完成影响力转型）
